WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(rfistat, 'No status') as rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
above_average_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.rfistat,
    sa.avg_modindex,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM status_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg
),
mean_of_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM above_average_statuses
)
SELECT 
  aas.rfistat,
  aas.avg_modindex,
  aas.avg_modindex - aas.overall_avg as above_average_amount,
  aas.avg_modindex - mq.mean_qualifying_avg as differs_from_mean
FROM above_average_statuses aas
CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying mq
